about: The launcher HTTP API of the PREVIOUS release, which the server calls (BOS-1227, the skew rule). A server one release newer or older than the launcher must still work: the launcher may add routes and response keys, never remove or rename one the previous server calls; the server may call a route the previous launcher lacks only if it is listed in the server's OPTIONAL_NEW_CALLS (and tolerates a 404). When a release ships, replace this file with the surface of the release before it.
